findings.message: id="01-pressure-world" starts with a digit, and the selector `#01-pressure-world` used in this composition is invalid: querySelector and GSAP throw a SyntaxError, and CSS drops the rule.
findings.fixHint: Rename the id to start with a letter (recommended), or build selectors with `#${CSS.escape(id)}` at runtime.

findings.message: Initial hidden state for "#p-question, #p-future, #p-free" is set via tl.set(...) at position 0 inside the paused timeline. A zero-duration set at 0 does not render while the playhead sits exactly at 0, so frame 0 shows the un-hidden state.
findings.fixHint: Use gsap.set(...) (immediate, outside the timeline) for initial states, or author the hidden state directly in CSS/attributes.

findings.message: Font family used without @font-face declaration: localsans. These are not in the auto-resolved font list, so the renderer cannot supply them automatically. Text will fall back to a generic font, producing incorrect typography in the video.
findings.fixHint: Add @font-face { font-family: '...'; src: url('capture/assets/fonts/...woff2'); } for each font family, pointing to the captured .woff2 files. For an OS-bundled system font (e.g. Hiragino Sans, Microsoft YaHei) that has no downloadable file, use src: local('Exact Font Name') instead. The declaration alone satisfies this check without needing a font file.
